mapper.sql: FROM test_execution e JOIN test_cycle c ON c.id = e.cycle_id JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = e.test_case_id WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.status != 'CLOSED' AND e.assignee_id = #{userId} AND e.result = 'NOT_RUN'
mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.cycle_id, c.cycle_no, c.name AS cycle_name, tc.tc_code, tc.title AS tc_title, tc.priority AS tc_priority
ORDER BY c.cycle_no DESC, CASE tc.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, tc.tc_code LIMIT #{limit}
